label: mid original phase (t>=3) of sequences starting with p or r
explanation: Very sparse feature (0.011% of steps). About 82% of activation mass is in the original phase at t=3..7 (peak t=4), and almost entirely in sequences whose first token is p (56% of mass, 17x lift) or r (22%). Firing is more likely when u, 0, n, q or a appeared in the prefix (prev2_tok u has 9x lift, prev_tok u/0 5-7x) and when the current input is a consonant such as r, t, c, z or g. Digits and a as the current input, and the earliest steps t=0..2, almost never fire. A smaller copy-phase share (16%) shows up around recall_idx 2-3, mostly when outputting p or r. The context is necessary but far from sufficient: under 1% of p/r-initial steps at t>=3 fire, and adding prefix and current-token conditions only raised dev F1 to about 0.14. Magnitude is fairly flat (median 0.12, max 0.23). The strongest examples have p-initial sequences with u or 0 within the first four tokens.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=r (+5.96), phase=2 & out_tok=p (+5.14), orig0=p (+5.02), orig0=r (+3.55), out_tok=r (+3.48), orig1=p (+3.12). Lower it: correct=1 (-5.30), orig_idx=-1 (-4.31), recall_idx=1 (-3.79), prev3_tok=- (-3.33).
